contexts.context: ...And many a lovely vale, ere he beheld Where <mark>Betis</mark> wandering thro the unbounded plain Roll’d his majestic waters....
...Shining majestic in the light of eve. Before them <mark>Betis</mark> rolld his glittering stream In many a silvery winding traced...
...on all sides the miscreant hosts move on, From southern <mark>Betis</mark>, from the western lands Where thro redundant vales smooth...
